exposure: Maternal dietary inflammatory index (DII) scores (Energy-adjusted-DII scores)
outcome: delivery outcomes (preterm delivery, large-for-gestational age delivery)
cohort: The study included 478 pregnant urban South African women participating in the Soweto First 1000-Day Study.
finding: Consumption of an anti-inflammatory diet during pregnancy was associated with a reduced risk of excessive gestational weight gain in urban South African women.
